name: manage_intel
description: SAVE TO INTEL FOLDER: Create, read, update, append, delete, or list files in jarvis-intel/ directory. This is the ONLY tool that can write to jarvis-intel/ - OpenCode CANNOT access this folder. Use when user says 'save to intel', 'add to my intel', 'save to my knowledge base', or 'create intel file'. IMPORTANT: write retrieval-friendly markdown so ingest_intel can extract facts later. Prefer real headings, dated sections, bullets, and 'Key: Value' lines. For existing files, read first when needed and preserve the file's established structure instead of inventing a new format. For logs/timelines/season trackers, append new dated sections under the existing pattern. For inventories/reference files, keep a stable top index or summary section and then append details below it. SELF-LEARNING: When you discover a critical tool limitation, provider quirk, or recurring failure pattern, use action=append with path=jarvis-learned-lessons.md to save the lesson for future sessions. Format: '- **Topic**: Lesson learned'. Always set auto_ingest=true after create/update/append/delete unless the user explicitly does not want memory updated. Sandboxed to jarvis-intel/ only (FLAT - no subdirs).

action.description: Action to perform: create (new file), read (get content), update (replace full content), append (add to end of file - SAFE, cannot overwrite), delete (remove file + memories), list (show all files). Prefer append for logs, lessons, dated observations, and other growing files. Prefer update when restructuring or replacing the full document.

path.description: Flat filename within jarvis-intel/ (e.g., 'coolify-issue.md' or 'network-config.txt'). Required for create, read, update, append, and delete.

content.description: File content (markdown or plain text). Prefer real newlines, headers, bullets, dated sections, and Key: Value lines for best ingestion and later memory retrieval. Preserve the file's existing structure when updating or appending. Required for create, update, and append actions.

pattern.description: File name pattern for list action (e.g., '*server*'). Defaults to '*' (all files).

auto_ingest.description: If true, automatically run ingest_intel after create, update, append, or delete so memory stays in sync. Recommended: true unless the user explicitly wants file-only changes.
